mentions.name: Fiber power glove robot game
mentions.description: A simple power-glove made from cheap Harbor Freight gloves with optical fiber routed through each finger using a needle, which the author plans to connect to a robotic arm to make a cool robot game.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also bought some cheap gloves from harbor freight and used a needle to route fiber through each finger to make a simple power glove like thing which I think I can connect to arm arm to make a cool robot game.
mentions.author: mrnotcrazy
